summary: Combined Noether R121 German web-review candidate for P09/P13/P16/P29. It bundles RA85-style section anchors for Papers 09-13 and 15, the targeted Paper 13 formula (6) dotted-row restoration, and prior targeted P16/P29 localfixes with source witnesses.
verification_summary: Candidate PDF was produced by XeLaTeX as a 458-page German cumulative.
P09/RA85 changes are structural section anchors for Papers 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, and 15.
P13 formula (6) dotted-row restoration is included with source p.238 witnesses.
P16 source-visible front matter/bracket labels and P29 first-page title/author/rule localfixes are carried forward with source witnesses.
Prior P10/P12 no-duplicate traps are included as context only.
limitations: Candidate review package only; not a promoted canonical branch.
P09 structural anchors do not certify P09 dense mathematical displays.
P13/P16/P29 source witnesses support targeted loci only, not full paper-level source certification.
Not Paper 09/13/16/29 closure, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
recommended_next_action: Use for web/local review and branch reconciliation. If promoted, propagate only after confirming the combined diff does not conflict with newer R121/R122 Noether branches and after preserving the explicit caveats.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
